The '''Ossel system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] located within the [[Bozhnee sector/Legends|Bozhnee sector]] of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim Territories]]. It contained the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ossel II]], [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of the [[Ossan]] [[Species/Legends|species]].
